All limiting/infinitely supported steps are analytical, not inferred from finite tests.

value.rationale: The integer one-step shape condition p_{m+1}>=p_m is a natural monotonicity criterion at the mean. It is outside the recent sharp theorem's stated gamma<=1/2 regime and gives an exactly optimized universal exceedance bound; the plastic constant and the unique geometric-tailed extremizer reveal a genuine change of extremal geometry. The constant and sharpness matter directly when transferring local mass information into tail guarantees for reliability and sampling distributions; the result does not require a broader downstream theorem to be useful.
